description: Source code for a plugin management and dynamic object handling in a C project, including functions for loading, freeing, and manipulating plugin objects and dynamic nodes.

methods.name: free_all_dynamic_nodes
methods.description: Recursively frees all dynamic nodes and associated memory in a DMOBJ structure.

methods.name: plugin_obj_match
methods.description: Matches a plugin object based on input parameter and node current object.

methods.name: dm_check_dynamic_obj
methods.description: Checks dynamic objects recursively to find a matching object.

methods.name: dm_check_dynamic_obj_entry
methods.description: Checks a specific dynamic object entry for a match.

methods.name: find_entry_obj
methods.description: Finds a specific entry object based on object path.

methods.name: disable_entry_obj
methods.description: Disables a specific entry object based on object path.

methods.name: disable_entry_leaf
methods.description: Disables a specific leaf parameter based on parameter path.

methods.name: get_entry_obj_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an entry object.

methods.name: get_entry_leaf_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an entry leaf.

methods.name: get_obj_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an array of entry objects.

methods.name: get_leaf_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of an array of entry leaves.

methods.name: load_plugins
methods.description: Loads plugin files (.json and .so) from a specified directory.

methods.name: free_plugins
methods.description: Frees all plugin-related dynamic nodes and plugin resources.
